entities.summary: Oleksandr Ivanovych Materukhin is a Ukrainian Belarusian professional former ice hockey right winger. He formerly played with Belarusian club, HC Dinamo Minsk of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). Internationally he played for both Ukraine and Belarus.
